description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for the PackageManagerImplementation, which manages package downloading, installation, and handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and internal data structures related to package management operations.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Represents the internal state of a package, including installation status, lock count, runtime configuration, and metadata paths.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: JSON configuration container for package manager settings, primarily the download directory.

classes.name: DownloadInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a download task, including URL, retries, rate limits, and cancellation status.

methods.name: PackageManagerImplementation
methods.description: Constructor for the PackageManagerImplementation class.

methods.name: ~PackageManagerImplementation
methods.description: Destructor for the PackageManagerImplementation class.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Initiates a package download given a URL and options.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses an ongoing download identified by downloadId.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused download identified by downloadId.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a downloaded file based on its locator.

methods.name: Progress
methods.description: Reports the progress percentage of a download.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves storage quota and used space details.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Sets a rate limit for a specific download.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for download events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered download notification callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the package manager with the given service context.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the package manager, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Installs a package with specified ID, version, and metadata.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a package by ID.

methods.name: ListPackages
methods.description: Lists all installed packages.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configures a package with specific metadata.

methods.name: PackageState
methods.description: Retrieves the current installation state of a package.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an installation notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an installation notification callback.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a package, preventing modifications.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a previously locked package.

methods.name: GetLockedInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a locked package.

methods.name: getRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Static method to populate runtime configuration from package metadata.

methods.name: getRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Static method to copy runtime configuration.

methods.name: createStorageManagerObject
methods.description: Creates the storage manager object.

methods.name: releaseStorageManagerObject
methods.description: Releases the storage manager object.
